content:
Login API একটি সিস্টেমের সবচেয়ে সংবেদনশীল এন্ডপয়েন্ট। এটি ঠিকমতো টেস্ট না করলে Security breach, account takeover এবং unauthorized access — সব ধরনের ঝুঁকি থেকে যায়।

একজন QA Engineer হিসেবে Login API টেস্টিংয়ে শুধু "সঠিক password দিলে login হয়" যাচাই করলেই হবে না। নিচে একটি Enterprise-grade Login API-এর সম্পূর্ণ Test Case suite দেওয়া হলো।

---

Positive Test Cases

TC-LOGIN-001: Valid email and valid password
Method : POST /api/auth/login
Body   : { "email": "user@test.com", "password": "Valid@123" }
Expected:
  - Status Code: 200 OK
  - Response contains: access_token, refresh_token, expires_in
  - Token is a valid JWT (3 parts, dot-separated)

TC-LOGIN-002: Login with Remember Me enabled
Body: { "email": "user@test.com", "password": "Valid@123", "rememberMe": true }
Expected:
  - Refresh token expiry extended (e.g., 30 days instead of 1 day)

TC-LOGIN-003: Login returns user role/permissions
Expected:
  - Response includes "role": "admin" or "user"
  - Permissions array present if applicable
---

Negative Test Cases

TC-LOGIN-004: Wrong password
Body: { "email": "user@test.com", "password": "WrongPass" }
Expected:
  - Status Code: 401 Unauthorized
  - Message: "Invalid email or password." (NOT "Password incorrect" — ব্যবহারকারীকে hint না দেওয়া)

TC-LOGIN-005: Non-existent email
Body: { "email": "ghost@test.com", "password": "Any@123" }
Expected:
  - Status Code: 401 (same as wrong password — enumeration ঠেকাতে)

TC-LOGIN-006: Empty email field
Body: { "email": "", "password": "Valid@123" }
Expected: 400 Bad Request, field validation error

TC-LOGIN-007: Empty password field
Body: { "email": "user@test.com", "password": "" }
Expected: 400 Bad Request, field validation error

TC-LOGIN-008: SQL Injection in email field
Body: { "email": "' OR '1'='1", "password": "any" }
Expected: 400 or 401 — must NOT return any data or 200

TC-LOGIN-009: XSS in email field
Body: { "email": "<script>alert(1)</script>@test.com", "password": "Valid@123" }
Expected: 400 Bad Request or sanitized/rejected
---

Security & Edge Case Tests

TC-LOGIN-010: Account lockout after N failed attempts
Steps: Send wrong password 5 times in a row
Expected:
  - 6th attempt returns 429 Too Many Requests or 423 Locked
  - Message: "Account temporarily locked. Try again in 15 minutes."

TC-LOGIN-011: Login with deactivated account
Expected: 403 Forbidden, "Account suspended or deactivated."

TC-LOGIN-012: Login with unverified email
Expected: 403 Forbidden, "Please verify your email before logging in."

TC-LOGIN-013: JWT token structure validation
Steps: Decode the returned access_token
Expected:
  - Header: { alg: "HS256" or "RS256", typ: "JWT" }
  - Payload contains: userId, email, role, iat, exp
  - exp is in the future (not expired)

TC-LOGIN-014: Concurrent login from two devices
Steps: Login from Device A, then login from Device B
Expected: Both get valid tokens (unless single-session policy enforced)
---

Response Header Verification

TC-LOGIN-015: Security headers present
Expected response headers:
  - X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  - X-Frame-Options: DENY
  - Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
  - Authorization header NOT returned (token should be in body)
---

পরিশেষে

Login API টেস্টিং শুধু happy path যাচাই করলেই যথেষ্ট নয়। Security test cases — SQL Injection, account lockout, enumeration prevention — এগুলো একটি production-ready সিস্টেমের জন্য আবশ্যিক।

Tags: #APITesting #LoginAPI #Authentication #JWT #SecurityTesting #QA #SQA
